description: Assertion-based mutations for wipe path length, the minimum wipe speed, and the inward-offset width clamp.

mutants.description: The positive 0.75 and 2 mm rows must clip the stored wipe path to the requested length. This mutation does not exercise the separate zero-distance gate.
The registered zero speed boundary must still emit the consumer's F600 floor; lowering it to F60 is observed in parsed wipe G-code.
A literal 2 mm inward offset must remain geometrically equivalent to the 100% wall-width clamp rather than overshooting the emitted wipe trajectory.
